subject.title: failureAlert (after=1) never fires on 2026.6.5 — every errored run stuck at delivery_status 'not-requested'

question: Should failureAlert trigger for every final cron result recorded as error, while the separate run-status work determines when a recovered agent run is allowed to become successful?
rationale: The expected alert behavior is established, but https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/112670 shows that some recorded errors may reflect recoverable intermediate tool failures; maintainers need to set the durable boundary between run classification and alerting.

options.title: Alert on final recorded errors
options.body: Send failure alerts after any final persisted error and address false error classification separately in the related run-status work.

options.title: Resolve status semantics first
options.body: Defer the alert-path change until maintainers define whether recovered tool failures should be recorded as success or error.

recommendation.title: Alert on final recorded errors
recommendation.body: Send failure alerts after any final persisted error and address false error classification separately in the related run-status work.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the failure-alert contract and is the strongest available feature-history routing candidate.
